text: Been trying to get through for ages. Foster parent, I've got an 8 month old girl. Her temp's 37.7. Snotty nose, sneezing all evening, nose sounds a bit blocked. She's also got a few insect bites on her legs that she keeps scratching at. She's wide awake, babbling at me now, totally alert, and her neck's fine - she can look right down at her feet no bother, I checked. I just want to know if I'm meant to do anything or if I can just get her settled. Would be nice to get an answer at some point tonight.
